name: What is involved in the tub-to-shower conversion process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the tub-to-shower conversion process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The tub-to-shower conversion process involves removing the existing bathtub and surrounding wall materials, making necessary plumbing adjustments for the new shower configuration, installing a new shower pan or custom sloped floor, waterproofing, and then tiling the walls and floor. Finally, new fixtures, a shower door or enclosure, and any storage niches are installed. As an integrated design-build team, AKN Design Group manages every step, from initial design concepts and material selection to permit coordination and construction, ensuring a seamless transformation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes removing the tub, adjusting plumbing, installing a new shower pan and waterproofing, tiling, and installing fixtures and an enclosure.
